entities.summary: Isabel Plácida Bonig Trigueros is a Spanish politician and lawyer who belongs to the People's Party and lawyer She was the mayor of the municipality of La Vall d'Uixó near Castellón between 2007 and 2011, and the Minister of Infrastructure, Territory and Environment of the Generalitat Valenciana between 2011 and 2015. She is, since July 28, 2015, President of the Popular Party of the Valencian Community. She is married and has no children.
